context: Yumiko and Hina watch a beautiful sunset.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ひなちゃん、夕焼け、見て、空、綺麗。
lines.en: Hina-chan, look at the sunset — the sky is so beautiful.
lines.style: Soft, wondering opening. Gentle nudge of attention toward her daughter. Warm throughout, like sharing something precious. Unhurried pace, tender but completely natural — no performance.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Bright, unselfconscious awe. Open vowels on the exclamation. Genuine wonder without overthinking it. The small gasp of a child who sees something and means it completely.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.en: Such a gentle color, isn't it.
lines.style: Reflective, almost to herself but inviting Hina in. Slow, contemplative pace. The tone of someone noticing something true about the world and wanting to point it out softly.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: I'm so happy we can see it together.
lines.style: Warm, direct sincerity. The natural emphasis lands on 'together'—not the seeing, but the shared seeing. Simple and unhurried, like the thought just arrived.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.style: Quieter, more inward. A small pause before speaking, like she's holding the moment. Tender and philosophical without sadness. The voice of someone aware this won't last and grateful for it now.
